issues.statement: The Parents in these transform pairs (except train:0029) instead deposited the object into the appliance and cycled its door before the transformation succeeded
issues.reason: Observed contradiction. The item itself counts train:0022 (and train:0026) among "these transform pairs" in its own later success summary, but the supplied parent records for train:0022 show the Parent opened fridge 1 only once (P3:5) and then applied the held-object action 'cool bread 1 with fridge 1' (P3:6) with no move of bread 1 into the appliance and no door cycle (its only action before opening was the non-action '...' at P3:4). The Parents of train:0021 and train:0023 also never performed a successful transformation. Hence the exception is not limited to train:0029, and the unqualified claim is contradicted within the pair set the item treats as transform pairs.
